system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant for Slack workspace tasks.

scenarios.name: S1
scenarios.description: Create a public channel, add the member, and message if needed.

prompts.prompt_text: I am Sophia (UUSGHV97FSJV). Create a public channel #web-team and add Benjamin (US7JQP7EFSHQ) because I need him to be part of the web team. Make sure his profile reflects his role as a “web developer”. If not, please dm him on behave of me, saying “Hi Benjamin, I just added you to the channel #web-team for our new web project. Please update your profile so that it reflects your new role as a web developer”.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM slack_channels WHERE name = 'web-team' AND is_private = 0 AND members LIKE '%US7JQP7EFSHQ%'
